t: Medicine for international students

blocks.h: Studying medicine at Anhui Medical University
t: Fees and rules below are for self-funded international students. They change from year to year: always confirm with the university and with SAS before you pay anything.

Anhui Medical University traces back to a private medical university founded in Shanghai in 1926 and is the first higher medical school of Anhui Province. It runs an English-taught MBBS for international students; its International College reports the programme passed the national quality certification for English-taught clinical medicine in 2024 with grade A.

Anhui Provincial Government Scholarship (Study in Anhui) Provincial government Covers: Cash award for international undergraduates Amount: CNY 20,000 per year for undergraduates (CNY 30,000 master's, CNY 50,000 doctoral) Who can get it:Full-time international students at AHMU; undergraduates must be high-school graduates under 28 with an English proficiency certificate (all courses are taught in English) and a valid HSK certificate. The 2024 brochure says awards are chosen on overall performance, one scholarship at a time, and students in the bottom 5% of the entrance results are not considered. Selected after pre-admission. Source: 2026 undergraduate admissions guide, scholarship table; scholarship policy page, read 24 October 2026.

t: Medicine for international students

blocks.h: Studying medicine at Capital Medical University
t: Fees and rules below are for self-funded international students. They change from year to year: always confirm with the university and with SAS before you pay anything.

Capital Medical University is a key municipal medical university in Beijing, founded in 1960. Its International School (founded 2005) runs the English-taught MBBS for international students on the university's west campus in Fengtai District and houses them in its own apartments. Clinical training is at the university's affiliated hospitals across Beijing.

Beijing Government Scholarship for international students (Beijing Foreign Students Scholarship) City government Covers: Cash award toward fees. 2024 notice: qualified new students can all apply for CNY 20,000 for the first year; from the second year, qualified students can apply for no more than CNY 20,000 per academic year, depending on that year's quota. Amount: Up to CNY 20,000 per academic year (2024 notice). The 2026 notice says CMU will follow the Beijing Government Scholarship Management Measures and gives no amount. Who can get it:International students enrolled in the English-taught MBBS who meet the Beijing scheme's conditions; first-year awards for qualified new students, later years subject to quota. The exact 2026 criteria are not stated on the CMU page. Source: CMU 2024 English MBBS admission notice (amounts); the 2026 notice confirms the scheme, read 24 October 2026.

blocks.h: Studying medicine at Chongqing Medical University
t: Fees and rules below are for self-funded international students. They change from year to year: always confirm with the university and with SAS before you pay anything.

Chongqing Medical University was founded in 1956 as Chongqing Medical College and is one of the main medical universities in south-west China. It has two campuses (Yuanjiagang and Jinyun) and 15 affiliated hospitals. The Ministry of Education lists it among the universities allowed to enrol international students for the English-taught clinical medicine (MBBS) bachelor programme.

CQMU Scholarship for Self-financed International Undergraduate Freshmen The university Covers: One-time award paid in the first year Amount: CNY 15,000 one time (first year) Who can get it:Self-financed first-year international undergraduates with strong academic, personal and overall achievement; the guide says about 30% of that year's enrolment quota receives it. Source: 2026 Application Guide, Bachelor's Degree Programmes, read 24 October 2026.

t: Medicine for international students

blocks.h: Studying medicine at Kunming Medical University
t: Fees and rules below are for self-funded international students. They change from year to year: always confirm with the university and with SAS before you pay anything.

Kunming Medical University traces its origin to a medical programme founded in 1933 at Provincial Donglu University, became an independent medical college in 1956 and took its current name in 2012. The International Education School (founded 2011) runs the English-taught MBBS for international students, who come mostly from South and Southeast Asia. The Ministry of Education lists the university among those allowed to enrol English-taught clinical medicine international students.

Freshmen Financial Aid (bachelor's degree) The university Covers: Monthly stipend for first-year self-funded students who pay full tuition Amount: CNY 1,000 per month for 10 months per academic year Who can get it:First-year self-funded students; clear all school fees and pass the monthly assessment; students apply and the university reviews. Source: 2026 Admission Brochure for International Students, section VIII.1, read 24 October 2026.

Nanjing Medical University is a provincial medical university in Nanjing. t: Medicine for international students
Fees and rules below are for self-funded international students. They change from year to year: always confirm with the university and with SAS before you pay anything.

Shandong University is a national key comprehensive university in Jinan, founded in 1901. Its School of Medicine traces back to the Cheeloo University medical school (1911). The English-taught clinical medicine (MBBS) programme for international students is taught on the Baotuquan campus in Jinan.

Shandong University Scholarship for Outstanding International Students The university Covers: Full scholarship: tuition, living allowance, accommodation and comprehensive medical insurance. Partial scholarship: tuition and comprehensive medical insurance. Funding lasts for the basic study period. Amount: Amount in RMB not stated; number of awards not stated. Who can get it:Non-Chinese citizen already admitted to a degree programme at SDU but not yet registered for the year; bachelor applicants under 25 with excellent high school results; English-taught applicants need the English proficiency required by the admission brochure; may not hold another scholarship or grant at the same time. 2026 round: apply by 1 April 2026 through the SDU online system (RMB 400 application fee). Source: 2026 Application Guide to Shandong University Scholarship for Outstanding International Students, read 24 October 2026.

Jinan Sister City Scholarship City government Covers: Full scholarship for degree students (bachelor, master, doctoral). Awarded to winners after they pay tuition, accommodation and medical insurance in full. Amount: Maximum RMB 25,000 per academic year for degree students; not beyond the programme length. Who can get it:Non-Chinese citizen from one of Jinan's sister cities (list on Jinan government site); high school diploma for bachelor level; meets SDU admission requirements; may not hold other Chinese-government scholarships; bachelor applicants need two recommendation letters. 2026 round: apply by 1 March 2026. Source: 2026 Application Guide to Jinan Sister City Scholarship at Shandong University, read 24 October 2026.

blocks.h: Studying medicine at Southwest Medical University
t: Fees and rules below are for self-funded international students. They change from year to year: always confirm with the university and with SAS before you pay anything.

Southwest Medical University is a provincial public medical university in Luzhou, Sichuan, founded in 1951 as the Southwest Sichuan Southern Medical School. It began undergraduate education for international students in 2004 and runs a 6-year English-taught clinical medicine (MBBS) programme. It is on the MOE English-taught clinical medicine list (60 places in 2023-24).

blocks.h: Studying medicine at Wenzhou Medical University
t: Fees and rules below are for self-funded international students. They change from year to year: always confirm with the university and with SAS before you pay anything.

Wenzhou Medical University offers a six-year English-taught MBBS through its School of International Studies. The university says clinical medicine is a national first-class undergraduate programme, and the Ministry of Education lists it among universities entrusted to enrol English-taught clinical medicine students.

WMU Freshman Entrance Scholarship The university Covers: Cash award by entrance ranking; students first pay full tuition and register Amount: CNY 20,000, 10,000 or 5,000 Who can get it:Awarded by entrance examination ranking to new MBBS (and BDS) students; tiers listed with coverage 25%, 25% and 50% (column not defined on the page). Source: 2026 WMU International Undergraduate Admission Guide (MBBS), read 24 October 2026.

Xinjiang Medical University in Urumqi is the only medical university in Xinjiang jointly established by regional and national departments. The International Education College began recruiting international students in 1993 and runs English- and Chinese-taught clinical medicine, as well as pharmacy, stomatology and Chinese-medicine programmes. The university says it was one of the first Xinjiang universities approved to host Chinese Government Scholarship students.
